PARSE_ERROR.description: Lexical or syntactic error in SQL text.

SEMANTIC_ERROR.description: Unknown/ambiguous table or column, misuse of aggregates, grouping violation, wrong function arity, invalid statement structure.

TYPE_ERROR.description: Operand or argument types are incompatible (detected at validation).

NUMERIC_OVERFLOW.description: Integer/decimal overflow, out-of-range literal or cast, non-finite float result.

CONVERSION_ERROR.description: A value could not be converted (CAST, ingestion with schema, invalid DATE/TIMESTAMP literal).

INVALID_ARGUMENT.description: Argument value outside the function's domain (e.g. SQRT(-1), negative LIMIT).

SUBQUERY_CARDINALITY.description: A scalar subquery returned more than one row.

INVALID_REQUEST.description: Malformed protocol request (bad JSON, unknown op, missing/ill-typed fields).

INGEST_ERROR.description: Malformed input data (CSV structure, JSON syntax, inconsistent JSON types, duplicate columns).

UNSUPPORTED.description: Syntactically valid feature or option this engine does not implement.

ACCESS_DENIED.description: Path outside the data directory or otherwise not permitted.

NOT_FOUND.description: Protocol-level reference to a missing table, index, query id or file.

CANCELLED.description: Query was cancelled by a client or by shutdown.

RESOURCE_LIMIT.description: A configured resource limit (rows, memory, input size, join size) was exceeded.

STORAGE_CORRUPT.description: Storage file failed validation (magic, checksum, truncation, structural inconsistency).

STORAGE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.description: Storage file format version is newer than supported.

INTERNAL_ERROR.description: Bug or unexpected condition. Conformance tests never expect this code.

OVERLOADED.description: Worker pool and queue are full (backpressure).

SHUTTING_DOWN.description: Server is draining and not accepting new queries.
